admission.justification: Historical: the clause was created on the three closeout-group tests, all of which this leaf deletes.

applicability: No longer applicable: the closeout validator this clause described is removed by 260928-MIK-L56.
exclusions: Nothing here asserts what the closeout does today; that rule, and its lack of a proof, are recorded elsewhere.

evidence: A legitimate complete run of an earlier candidate is refused by name ("its code candidate tree is 'fb59baa4…', this candidate's is '1004c29c…'") and a bound current run still closes the same row in all three consumers; a card added to a grouped member after the run is refused naming the group and the member.

statement: The closeout validator uses a persisted worklist run's identical-copy groups only when that run describes the candidate being certified. This sentence is retired at 260928-MIK-L56: the validator it describes is deleted.
